title: Venue Operations Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
description:
Venue Operations Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil


Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.


THE POSITION

Reporting to Senior Venue Operations Manager, and working alongside the FIFA Tournament & Venue Operations team in Zurich, the Venue Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring that the stadium is delivered in full compliance with FIFA Hosting Requirements and for leading the operational delivery of all FWWC2027 matches and non-matchday activities at the venue.
The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting one Venue Operations Manager for each host city:

  • Belo Horizonte - Estádio Mineirão
  • Brasília - Estádio Nacional
  • Fortaleza - Arena Castelão
  • Porto Alegre - Estádio Beira-Rio
  • Recife - Arena de Pernambuco
  • Rio de Janeiro - Estádio do Maracanã
  • Salvador - Arena Fonte Nova
  • São Paulo - Arena Itaquera

Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.

The position requires the effective and efficient management of all venue operations, ensuring seamless coordination with FIFA’s functional areas as well as internal and external stakeholders. Key areas of focus include transparency, communication, issue escalation, problem-solving, innovation, and the use of reporting tools to guarantee operational excellence.

The Venue Operations Manager will act as a coordinator, facilitator, and decision-maker at the stadium. Together with the FIFA27 Senior Venue Manager, the FIFA FWWC Lead Venue Management team, and the FIFA27 Head of Operations, this role holds ultimate responsibility for venue event planning, operational readiness, and on-site implementation, in close collaboration with all stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for the operational delivery of each match day and non-match day at the venue.
  • Will liaise with all functional areas including Competitions, Broadcast, Media, Dressing & Signage, Fan Operations, Pitch Management, Partnerships Rights Delivery, Technical Services & Overlay, Stadium Entertainment, Ticketing, Hospitality, Technology, FTI (Football Technology Innovation), Catering as well as other functional areas such as Services (Logistics, Transport, Guest Management) and Safety, Security, Accreditation & Access and Workforce and Volunteer Management, to ensure the smooth, efficient and effective operation at the venue for all constituent groups.
  • Establish constructive communication channels between FIFA, FIFA27, venue and local authorities and stakeholders.
  • Co-ordinate with all stakeholders (i.e. Host City authorities, venue operators, public transport, police & emergency services) at a venue level through regular coordinated meetings and/or workshops, to ensure the smooth running of events at the venue.
  • To integrate all relevant operational plans into effective venue plans.
  • To assess and validate FIFA’s event requirements to the reality of the venue.
  • Integration of all relevant functional area operational plans into the stadium environment.
  • Risk identification and mitigation across the venue.
  • Supervise and support stadium renovation and construction projects, assuring FIFA requirements are met.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Contribution to workshops, seminars and meetings with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Coordination of policies, requirements and planning with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Co-ordination, planning and delivery of official test events.
  • Plan, manage and implement a good quality and cost-efficient on-site support, service and operations for all relevant FIFA departments as well as other stakeholders (i.e. sponsors, service providers, etc.).
  • Organize and lead Stadium Inspection Tours.
  • Full support to functional areas on site visits, activities and post inspection BIM360 follow up.
  • Manage and review the Stadium budget including regular reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 8 years of management experience in multi-purpose arenas, professional sports clubs, or large-scale international sporting events.
  • Proven ability to lead large, multidisciplinary teams with strong stakeholder management skills across international and multicultural environments.
  • Excellent communication and crisis management skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure and provide decisive leadership.
  • Strong knowledge of event planning, operations, and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with the host stadium and its operational environment will be considered an asset.
  • Demonstrated experience in the development and integration of operational plans across multiple functional areas (e.g., security, spectator services, media, broadcast, hospitality).
  • Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large-scale events.
  • Strong understanding of health & safety, risk management, and security regulations in stadium operations.
  • Proven track record in managing complex international projects involving multiple stakeholders and authorities.

Education

  • University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
  • Bilingual - Brazilian Portuguese and English
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong team player, able to work collaboratively while meeting tight deadlines.
  • Solution-oriented mindset with persistence, resilience, and a positive attitude under pressure.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads efficiently during peak operational periods.
  • Sound judgment, critical problem-solving ability, and capacity to make key decisions under pressure.
  • Effective leadership skills, including motivational leadership, negotiation, and relationship management.
  • High levels of energy, adaptability, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Experience or knowledge of the local culture and market will be considered an advantage.
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-changing environment.
  • Adaptable and culturally sensitive, with proven experience working across international and cross-cultural contexts.


Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or able to relocate there independently

title: ENFERMEIRO GENERALISTA - CENTRO OBSTÉTRICO - MATERNIDADE MARIA AMÉLIA BUARQUE DE HOLLANDA
description:
Overview


O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações têm por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistenciais estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação de risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada. Inaugurada em 2012, a Maternidade oferta atividades assistenciais 24 horas por dia, todos os dias, incluindo sábados, domingos e feriados. O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.


Responsabilidades e atribuições



  • Organizar a operacionalização do serviço de Enfermagem e garantir o bom andamento dos serviços; realizar orientações aos pacientes; manter controle de salas, equipamentos e leitos disponíveis; orientar o trabalho da equipe de técnicos;

  • Atender às normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);

  • Garantir o cumprimento das rotinas, normas e protocolos institucionais e de SMS;

  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao usuário, desde a sua admissão, e acompanhar o atendimento técnico;

  • Atuar como facilitador de todos os processos que envolvem o atendimento de enfermagem;

  • Promover, juntamente ao gestor, ambiente que proporcione melhorias contínuas no processo assistencial;

  • Manter a comunicação com o corpo clínico, referente a mudanças no fluxo da Assistência de Enfermagem (quando interferir em processo médico);

  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem segura, humanizada e individualizada aos pacientes;

  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas junto aos serviços de saúde, colaborando para o controle de infecção;

  • Ministrar treinamentos quando necessário promovendo atualização contínua à equipe de enfermagem;

  • Auxiliar o gestor no controle de certificação profissional da equipe de enfermagem junto ao conselho de classe, bem como executar o processo de comunicação junto aos órgãos competentes;

  • Conduzir a gestão das notificações de não conformidades de avaliação de eficácia, referentes à Assistência de Enfermagem;

  • Gerir o controle de entrada e saída de materiais estocados no setor, mantendo o estoque mínimo necessário para o desenvolvimento da Assistência de Enfermagem;

  • Preencher e supervisionar o preenchimento dos registros específicos da Assistência de Enfermagem;

  • Assegurar a correta utilização dos equipamentos e acessórios disponíveis para o processo assistencial;

  • Prestar assistência a pacientes graves, desde a admissão, e acompanhá-los em caso de remoção a outro serviço;

  • Organizar o processo de armazenamento de receituários controlados;

  • Organizar e controlar o processo de esterilização de materiais;

  • Supervisionar ou acompanhar a realização de procedimentos assistenciais, enfocando segurança e diminuição de riscos de infecção;

  • Acompanhar a eficácia da escala de serviços da equipe de enfermagem;

  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir normas e recomendações de Biossegurança, mantendo o ambiente seguro para o paciente e a equipe multiprofissional;

  • Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e/ou residência no seu setor de trabalho;

  • Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato;

  • Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolvam a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes;

  • Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino.

  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;

  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.

  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.


Requisitos e qualificações



  • Possuir Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.

  • Possuir Pós-graduação - especialização completa em Obstetrícia.

  • Possuir Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

  • Possuir experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Enfermeiro em Maternidade.

  • Possuir fácil acesso ao Centro do Rio.

  • Possuir disponibilidade total para atuar em formato de plantão 12x60 (plantão a ser definido).


Informações adicionais



  • Trabalho 100% presencial;

  • Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio;

  • Horário de trabalho: Escala 12x60 - plantão ainda a ser definido;

  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculos com grau de parentesco ou atividade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador) deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Account Executive, Public Sector (LATAM)

The sales team responsible for our Government sector in LATAM is driven by our mission to make the world a safer place by tracking and investigating activities that involve cryptocurrency like human trafficking, terrorist financing, and money-laundering. We’re experts on the “why” and the “how” with deep relationships and knowledge of navigating government sales processes.

As an Account Executive, you'll establish trust and build strong relationships with Public Sector stakeholders, tailoring your sales approach to meet their needs, and evangelizing Chainalysis solutions in a compelling yet approachable way. You'll measure your success by attainment of assigned quota, accuracy of forecasting, and the growth of accounts in the region. The ideal candidate is an expert at navigating complex sales cycles, building a calculated account plan, and still enjoys the thrill of closing a deal.

In this role, you'll:

  • Achieve your revenue targets and increase our foothold in the government and public sector markets within LATAM through strategic prospecting and expanding existing accounts

  • Build and strengthen relationships with prospective and existing customers, driving new business, expansions, upsells, renewals, and cross-sales

  • Work closely with our Pre-Sales, Customer Success, Investigations, and Marketing teams to lead conversations within your territory

  • Create a diverse pipeline of opportunities, leveraging data from sales figures, marketing campaigns, and promotional activities to drive consistent and accurate forecasting

  • Develop a deep understanding of Chainalysis’ solutions, customer stakeholders, use cases, and key decision-making criteria within your market

  • Provide feedback and insight to help develop compelling product positioning and messaging specific to market trends, competitive drivers, region-specific sales channels, and more

  • Establish relationships across departments at Chainalysis, allowing you to provide expert advice to prospects related to technical concepts, product roadmaps, solutions implementations, and training

  • Demonstrate exceptional expertise in sales forecasting, ensuring precise and reliable predictions to drive informed decision-making and maximize business growth.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • A track record of over-achievement in a public sector sales role, selling to law enforcement and intelligence agencies in LATAM

  • A solid understanding of procurement processes involved in government sales, as well as experience selling with and through channel partners

  • An articulate, enthusiastic, and effective communication style with the ability to convey complex concepts in an approachable and concise way

  • Extensive experience discovering, managing and closing complex software sales in Brazil

  • Experience creating territory and account plans using value selling methodologies

  • An entrepreneurial and relentless hunting attitude with a willingness to prospect

  • The ability to negotiate terms and conditions and other concessions in complex, multi-year sales agreements

  • An insatiable curiosity and willingness to learn about blockchain technology and cryptocurrency

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese

About Chainalysis

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, and investigate criminal cases. As adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. title: Senior Manager, Legal Counsel FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to FWWC2027 Head of Event Legal, and working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Zurich, the Senior Manager, Legal Counselis responsible for the provision of legal support in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27.

This key position plays an integral part in ensuring the successful organization and staging of FWWC27. The successful candidate will be expected to pick up the responsibilities of the role and deliver results from the outset, working in a collaborative and constructive way across all functional areas connected to the delivery of FWWC27.

The role of Senior Legal Counsel for FWWC27 will be based in the Tournament HQ in Rio de Janeiro and is a full time role, but the term of employment is limited in length and will cease at the end of the FWWC27 once any necessary post-tournament requirements are fulfilled.

Key responsibilities

  • Providing legal support to FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27 across a broad range of legal areas, working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami.
  • Planning, setting up and implementing, in collaboration with the FIFA Legal team and FIFA Finance, the tax and corporate structure of FIFA27.
  • Assisting with all corporate, company secretarial and governance matters in respect of FIFA27, including legal, regulatory and FIFA institutional requirements and best practices.
  • Ensuring that the operation of FIFA27 and the staging and organization of FWWC27 complies with all applicable laws and regulations, including all federal, state and municipal laws and regulations.
  • Delivering all necessary legal advice, strategic direction and support during the operational phase, tournament time and wind-down phase of the FWWC27.

Advising, alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami, on the implementation of the legal framework for the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including:

  • Advising on the implementation of the hosting documentation provided during the bidding process for FWWC27, including hosting agreements, host city agreements, stadium agreements, training site agreements, airport agreements, accommodation agreements and related contractual documentation;
  • Supervising the implementation of the guarantees provided by Brazilian government during the bidding process for FWWC27 across topics such as taxation, immigration, employment and customs; and
  • Supporting the Head of Legal and senior management in its discussions with the Brazilian government and CBF and on the establishment of a FWWC27 event law.

Additional specific areas of responsibility include:

  • Drafting and negotiating service provider agreements and any other contracts to be entered into by FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27;
  • Managing any contentious matters and disputes that may arise in connection with FWWC27;
  • Advising FIFA and FIFA27 on employment and labour law matters, including drafting employment and human resources contracts, documentation and policies and dealing with employment and labour law disputes;
  • Managing external counsel; and
  • Supporting brand protection and anti-ambush marketing activities as part of the overall brand protection plan developed by FIFA.
  • Coordinating and working closely with other legal divisions within FIFA in relation to the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including in relation to media rights, TV production, content, music, technology, intellectual property, brand protection, sponsorship, marketing, corporate and institutional matters.

Your profile

  • An experienced and skilled lawyer qualified in Brazil with at least 10+ years of experience either in a top firm, large corporate or sporting organization, with experience advising major multinational organizations on a wide range of legal issues.
  • Experience with Administrative and Regulatory Law, Contractual and Civil Law consultancy, Compliance and Data Protection is desirable.
  • Previous experience of legal experience in the sports industry is desirable, particularly experience with the hosting and staging of major sports events. Candidates with a demonstratable interest in the sports industry and a strong commercial legal background will also be considered.
  • Experience recruiting and managing a team.
  • Keen understanding of the various interests and demands of all key stakeholders of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and a thorough appreciation of how the actions of FIFA27 could affect those interests.
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA Senior Management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Capacity to advise the business when making key decisions through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Qualified as an attorney in Brazil
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Technical Product Manager III
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Technical Product Manager III role at Outliant .

Outliant is a fully-remote, US-based, digital product development and startup consulting company with a team of diverse creators who help conceive seamless digital products. Our teams emphasize growth, creativity, and the freedom to think outside the box.

About This Role

We’re looking for a Technical Product Manager with a strong analytical mindset and a proven ability to lead platform-focused initiatives. You’ll join one of our most strategic accounts: a fast-scaling wellness company with a national footprint in the US.

This is not a feature factory role. You’ll be driving cross-functional outcomes , owning platform reliability and scalability , and partnering closely with engineering, SEO, and CRO teams to deliver meaningful impact.

You’ll operate within a newly structured product org where “stability & enablement” is a core business unit — and platform work is treated as first-class priority. This role reports directly to internal product leadership and collaborates with senior stakeholders across engineering, data, SEO, and design.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the platform roadmap: manage initiatives related to site architecture, CMS performance, scalability, QA and SEO foundations — ensuring readiness for 5x growth in clinics and locations.
  • Be technical and decisive: work closely with engineers to debug, unblock, and scope technical solutions. You’ll often be the bridge between messy reality and scalable execution.
  • Drive clarity and impact: translate business outcomes into clear product specs, track results, and relentlessly prioritize high-leverage opportunities.
  • Lead discovery & validation: partner with PMs and stakeholders to validate and prioritize internal and client-facing requests using a structured intake and scoring system.
  • Support SEO enablement: while you won’t own SEO strategy, you’ll ensure the technical platform supports the SEO team’s roadmap — including performance, schema, and scalable content rollout.
  • Own documentation & communication: write clear PRDs, surface tradeoffs, and ensure shared understanding across engineering, QA, and stakeholders.
  • Manage cross-team dependencies: coordinate work between engineering, QA, data, and operations — ensuring blockers are addressed and initiatives stay aligned to roadmap outcomes.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3+ years as a Product Manager, ideally with a technical or platform focus.
  • Background in engineering or strong technical fluency (e.g., able to discuss code, debug issues, or evaluate feasibility).
  • Experience managing CMS-based systems (e.g., Webflow or headless CMS) at scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across disciplines — engineering, SEO, design — and drive cross-functional alignment.
  • Highly analytical — able to define success metrics, pull data, and present insights to drive prioritization and decision-making.
  • Hands-on experience with modern product development practices: agile, Kanban, discovery frameworks, backlog grooming, etc.
  • Strong written communication skills. Clear PRDs and structured documentation are table stakes.

What’s in it for you?

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Non-working holidays per country of residence
  • Referral bonuses
  • Monthly internet stipend
  • Fun and casual work environment
  • Employee engagement activities and virtual gatherings
  • We are a diverse, global team!

Important Notice

To ensure the legitimacy of job opportunities, we strongly recommend that you solely rely on positions posted here on our official website: outliant.com/careers .

All our current job openings require video interviews conducted in either or both synchronous (via Google Meet) and asynchronous (via Willo) formats. Kindly refrain from accepting offers that appear suspicious. For any inquiries or concerns, feel free to reach out to us via email at .

Please be assured that we are fully committed to maintaining integrity in our hiring process.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: GERENTE DE MARKETING (BRANDING)
description:
Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos, mais simples, eficientes e eficazes.

Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, economizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Vaga

Gerente de Marketing (Branding) para planejar e executar nosso projeto de marca, estrategicamente alinhado à visão de negócios da Qive. Você será o embaixador da marca, liderando criativos, mensagens-chave e tom de voz, canais proprietários, design, conteúdo, comunicação, PR, palco de eventos, patrocínios, co-Marketing/co-branded, estudos de mercado e thought leadership. Buscamos um líder que posicione o time de Branding como protagonista e seja a força-motriz de um posicionamento de liderança de mercado da Qive.

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Gestão de marca: liderar e gerenciar atributos, ativos e mensagens-chave da marca Qive, supervisionando o posicionamento visual e verbal da marca, garantindo a entrega coesa das mensagens estratégicas em todas as plataformas e canais. Gerenciar times criativos internos e terceirizados – design, vídeo e redação.
  • Presença, saúde e impacto de marca: monitorar e avaliar a presença e saúde da marca Qive. Avaliar engajamento e geração de demanda por meio de redes sociais, eventos do setor e outros canais. Monitorar, otimizar e reportar KPIs e resultados periodicamente, garantindo a melhor alocação dos recursos.
  • Comunicação & PR: liderar e executar estratégias para o mercado brasileiro, gerenciando times internos e agência de PR terceirizada. Apoiar a presença digital de executivos-chave da Qive nas redes sociais e outros canais.
  • Palcos de eventos: planejar, conquistar e executar palcos de eventos que gerem demanda e fortaleçam thought leadership.
  • Patrocínios e co-MKT: avaliar, planejar, negociar e executar ações co-branded que fortaleçam a marca da Qive, gerando thought leadership.
  • Thought leadership e estudos de mercado: planejar e executar a estratégia de posicionamento e thought leadership da Qive, incluindo liderar e executar constantes e profundos estudos de mercado sobre o universo do Contas a Pagar.
  • Liderança e atividades executivas: liderar os times de PR, comunicação, e criativos. Estimular a colaboração com executivos e equipes de Marketing para potencializar o impacto da marca.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Marketing B2B Enterprise, e histórico comprovado na criação de estratégias de marca B2B (você deve ser capaz de apresentar casos, de sucesso ou não).
  • Ampla experiência em gestão de marca, conteúdo, criativos, comunicação e PR.
  • Experiência comprovada no uso de IA LLM para escala de produção de conteúdo em Marketing.
  • Mentalidade de negócios: os resultados do seu trabalho serão medidos pelo sucesso do negócio e influência no pipeline comercial, e presença e saúde da marca.
  • Forte capacidade de colaboração: habilidade para construir relacionamentos em todos os níveis da organização e influenciar stakeholders. Entendimento fundamental do papel da transparência e do trabalho em equipe.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais.
  • Habilidade de negociação e organização.
  • Criatividade e orientação para soluções. Visão ampla aplicada, sem perder a atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de planejamento estratégico e execução.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 avançados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade e Privacidade

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive. Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. A Qive não terá acesso a nenhum outro dado que esteja fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade de coleta é tão somente para identificação, comunicação e análise das pessoas candidatas.

Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Logo, caso você esteja se candidatando às nossas vagas por um meio que não seja o nosso site oficial ou pela InHire, recomenda-se a leitura dos termos e políticas próprias de cada um.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a passionate group from diverse backgrounds, united by the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy.

The core values guiding Ledn are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services.

The Opportunity: We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate will wear many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is adaptable to a fast-moving, security-first environment.

This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing and serve as the first line of support for employees via channels such as Slack and Jira; manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own and document solutions, policies, and tools; craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs and policies; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM, Jamf).
  • Own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.); work with API integrations between systems.
  • Detail solutions and communicate effectively; manage, respond to, and resolve incidents as needed; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects over sprints (agile).
  • Set personal objectives and align them with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open-source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; working with APIs and cross-system integrations.
  • Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; ability to ship and receive hardware and handle customs processes.
  • Excellent communication skills across media; clear writing for tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, concise writing; sensitivity to diverse cultures; commitment to a positive experience for others and strong security mindset (PGP).
  • Strong networking fundamentals and troubleshooting skills (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching); methodical OSI-layer troubleshooting.
  • Self-management to scope projects and prioritize across multiple teams; strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable with ambiguity.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools; Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We value adaptability, resilience, collaboration, empathy, and integrity; experience working in remote environments; ability to influence across functions and cultures.

What Ledn Provides

  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one; competitive PTO; ownership through equity; remote-friendly policy up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career and an inclusive, diverse, equal-opportunity environment.

Additional Information

  • You may reach Ledn for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process; inquiries will be confidential.
  • Ledn operates a remote-first environment; due to high volume of applications, only those who qualify will be contacted.
  • As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, no unsolicited resumes.

Location and Seniority: Mid-Senior level, Full-time, Information Technology. Industry: Retail. Seniority and job function are shown for descriptor purposes.

Overview

Information Technology Manager at Ledn. Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders and build generational wealth for the future.

Ledn offers a suite of lending, savings, and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values integrity, progress, and empathy.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The role requires wearing many hats, including end-user support, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. The right candidate will have demonstrated success in similar roles within fast-growing, security-first environments and will be passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code. You will design, implement, and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks and collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholders across the organization.

You will be customer-facing and serve as the first line of support for employees via tools such as Slack and Jira. This role involves procuring and delivering technology equipment, managing onboarding and offboarding, and documenting programs, policies, and tooling. You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoints and MDM/EMM tools. You will contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools and write knowledge articles and automations. You will manage incidents and priorities, participate in agile sprints, and align objectives with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc., and to integrate APIs across systems.
  • Experience with SSO (Okta) and IAM workflows; familiarity with remote support across time zones.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to craft clear tickets, emails, and articles; customer-focused and able to handle frustrated users calmly.
  • Proficiency with macOS in an enterprise environment, troubleshooting, and terminal usage.
  • Experience with security practices, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs), and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and collaborate across multiple teams.
  • Nice-to-have: AWS familiarity, GAM and CLI tooling, Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications, and experience in a remote/high-growth setting.

Culture and Qualities

  • Leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment, with integrity, accountability, empathy, and a builder mindset.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and delivering results in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures.

Benefits and Environment

  • Comprehensive total rewards package, generous PTO, and ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote work opportunity for up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • Equal opportunity employer; inclusive culture; accommodation requests available during recruitment.

Additional Information

Ledn operates globally with a remote-first approach. Due to high application volumes, qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response. No agencies or recruiters, and no unsolicited resumes.

A career with us is more than just a job. It''s an opportunity to connect and care for our patients, providers, communities and each other. We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.   • Remote IT support across multiple countries/time zones; hardware shipping/receiving and customs experience.
  • Strong communication skills across all media; clear writing for tickets, email, and Slack.

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM/CLI for efficient IT operations; relevant certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace).

Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. Applicants may contact the Ledn team for accommodation requests during the recruitment process. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to provide a short video response or review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

O foco principal será o monitoramento e a otimização da força de trabalho por meio da análise de métricas críticas como Turnover, Absenteísmo, Afastamentos, Produtividade e outros indicadores de capital humano.

Parceria Estratégica: Colaborar ativamente com as áreas de RH, Finanças e Liderança para traduzir desafios de negócios em perguntas analíticas e desenvolver soluções baseadas em dados.

Governança de Dados: Definir e implementar padrões de qualidade, segurança e sigilo na manipulação de dados sensíveis de pessoas.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo em áreas de Exatas (Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Ciência da Computação, Economia ou afins). Pós-graduação em Data Science, Analytics ou áreas correlatas é um diferencial.

  • Proficiência Absoluta em Microsoft Excel: Capacidade de utilizar recursos avançados como Power Query, modelos de dados, funções complexas e VBA (desejável).

Habilidades Comportamentais:

description:
Ad Tech Developer – Header Bidding (Remote)

At MonetizeMore, we’re all about using data to transform how the advertising industry tackles IVT (Invalid Traffic) and fraud prevention. Our products deliver real impact—and we need top-tier talent to help sell this premium AI product to better protect ad monetized publishers and ad tech vendors.

For 15 years, we’ve been driven by a team of 100+ talented professionals across the globe. As a 100% remote and culture-centric organization, we are built on the core pillars of Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen, ensuring excellence in everything we do.

About The Role

MonetizeMore is seeking an Ad Tech Developer with in-depth expertise in header bidding to build, optimize, and scale programmatic monetization for premium publishers. You’ll own end-to-end header bidding implementations (with a heavy focus on Prebid.js), improve auction performance, and partner with product, yield, and publisher success teams to deliver revenue-lifting results with excellent user experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Design & implement header bidding stacks using Prebid.js (web) and related wrappers; configure bidders, floors, price granularity, userId modules, and analytics
  • Customize & extend adapters/modules (e.g., userId, analytics, consent) and contribute clean, documented JavaScript/TypeScript code
  • Integrate with GAM/Ad Manager (GPT): line item strategy, key-values, creative templates, and troubleshooting of delivery and competition
  • Optimize auctions & latency: tune timeouts, s2s vs. client, floors, ad refresh logic, and page performance (CLS/LCP/INP/Core Web Vitals)
  • Run experiments: A/B test bidders, formats, and page placements; build dashboards to track impact (e.g., eCPM, viewability, fill, latency)
  • Debug complex issues across browser, network, and auction layers (DevTools, HAR/Waterfall, Charles/Proxyman); resolve revenue dips & bidder errors
  • Implement privacy & compliance: IAB TCF, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, CMP integration, consent storage, and geo-specific behaviors
  • Work with partners: SSPs, exchanges, ID providers, and analytics vendors to launch new demand and troubleshoot
  • Ship quality safely: use Git, CI/CD, code review, and observability to keep releases fast and reliable
  • Document & mentor: write clear runbooks and help level up teammates

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–6+ years of front-end or full-stack experience with a strong JavaScript foundation (TypeScript a plus)
  • 2–4+ years hands-on with header bidding (Prebid.js required); experience with s2s/managed wrappers (e.g., Prebid Server, Amazon TAM/UAM) is a plus
  • Solid understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM/GPT) setups, line items & creatives, key-values, targeting, and delivery debugging
  • Working knowledge of programmatic concepts: OpenRTB, floors, auction dynamics, user sync/ID, brand safety, and viewability
  • Familiarity with privacy frameworks & CMPs (IAB TCF v2.x, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA) and consent-aware ad serving
  • Performance tuning for Core Web Vitals and modern build tools (Webpack/Vite/Rollup)
  • Comfort with Chrome DevTools, network waterfalls, and log-driven debugging; bonus points for Node.js, Cloud Functions, or simple backend endpoints
  • Data fluency: basic SQL or BI tools (Looker/Data Studio/BigQuery) for revenue & latency analysis
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; bias for automation and measurable outcomes

Nice to Have

  • Experience with app/webview monetization, AMP, or SPA frameworks (React/Vue/Svelte)
  • Prebid analytics adapters or custom reporting pipelines
  • Experience with ads.txt/app-ads.txt, sellers.json, supply chain object
  • Knowledge of brand safety & IVT controls, creative QA, and MRC viewability standards
  • Exposure to video (IMA/OMSDK, Prebid Video, VAST/VPAID/VMAP) or CTV/OTT
  • Knowledge in Python and NoSQL is a plus

Why MonetizeMore

  • Remote-first culture with flexible work hours
  • Impact at scale across a large publisher network
  • Smart, low-ego teammates and a culture of experimentation
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, home-office stipend, and learning budget

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals. You will work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

What You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data. Nice to Haves: Some familiarity with AWS, but you will not need certifications. You\'ll have used these environments a bit. You\'ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will: Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. description:

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Canonical has a large and rapidly growing kernel team that underpins Ubuntu and open source more widely across a very wide range of hardware and use cases. We partner with the biggest kernel contributors - the silicon companies - to ensure that their work reaches the widest possible audience as quickly as possible, with a 10 year enterprise security commitment.

The Canonical Linux Kernel Organization has teams in every time zone. We have opportunities for technical leadership, engineering management, and engineering directorships. The team is responsible for all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels, on all platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large scale cloud environments, mainframes and supercomputers.

We care most about hardware and virtualization enablement, security, reliability and performance. There are a number of areas where we lead upstream, but for the most part we are interested in ensuring production readiness and performance for the latest patch-sets, rather than subsystem maintenance or evolution.

Kernel Team projects include but are not limited to:

  • Ubuntu Linux kernel plan, execution, benchmarking and stress testing
  • Optimized kernels for key silicon and cloud partners
  • Confidential computing and next-generation security primitives
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Kernel Livepatch, which delivers critical kernel fixes without rebooting
  • FIPS compliance
  • Real-Time and Low Latency kernel variants and patch-sets
  • Virtualization or abstraction engines
  • Container technology
  • Security with AppArmor, SECCOMP, namespaces and more
  • Networking - in particular performance and security
  • Storage - we are particularly interested in Ceph and DRBD

We hire candidates of all experience levels from recent university graduates through seasoned industry experts. We select those who are enthusiastic to work in multiple areas including security mitigation, feature development, patching and test. You must have outstanding academic results, a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and – with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan – have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.

What the role entails

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of a flavour of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Solid background with git
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Understanding of Linux kernel upstream processes and release cycle
  • Performance engineering and security experience
  • Solid background in CI/CD and process automation
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Ad Tech Developer – Header Bidding (Remote)
description:
Ad Tech Developer – Header Bidding (Remote)

At MonetizeMore, we’re all about using data to transform how the advertising industry tackles IVT (Invalid Traffic) and fraud prevention. Our products deliver real impact—and we need top-tier talent to help sell this premium AI product to better protect ad monetized publishers and ad tech vendors.

For 15 years, we’ve been driven by a team of 100+ talented professionals across the globe. As a 100% remote and culture-centric organization, we are built on the core pillars of Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen, ensuring excellence in everything we do.

About The Role

MonetizeMore is seeking an Ad Tech Developer with in-depth expertise in header bidding to build, optimize, and scale programmatic monetization for premium publishers. You’ll own end-to-end header bidding implementations (with a heavy focus on Prebid.js), improve auction performance, and partner with product, yield, and publisher success teams to deliver revenue-lifting results with excellent user experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Design & implement header bidding stacks using Prebid.js (web) and related wrappers; configure bidders, floors, price granularity, userId modules, and analytics
  • Customize & extend adapters/modules (e.g., userId, analytics, consent) and contribute clean, documented JavaScript/TypeScript code
  • Integrate with GAM/Ad Manager (GPT): line item strategy, key-values, creative templates, and troubleshooting of delivery and competition
  • Optimize auctions & latency: tune timeouts, s2s vs. client, floors, ad refresh logic, and page performance (CLS/LCP/INP/Core Web Vitals)
  • Run experiments: A/B test bidders, formats, and page placements; build dashboards to track impact (e.g., eCPM, viewability, fill, latency)
  • Debug complex issues across browser, network, and auction layers (DevTools, HAR/Waterfall, Charles/Proxyman); resolve revenue dips & bidder errors
  • Implement privacy & compliance: IAB TCF, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, CMP integration, consent storage, and geo-specific behaviors
  • Work with partners: SSPs, exchanges, ID providers, and analytics vendors to launch new demand and troubleshoot
  • Ship quality safely: use Git, CI/CD, code review, and observability to keep releases fast and reliable
  • Document & mentor: write clear runbooks and help level up teammates

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–6+ years of front-end or full-stack experience with a strong JavaScript foundation (TypeScript a plus)
  • 2–4+ years hands-on with header bidding (Prebid.js required); experience with s2s/managed wrappers (e.g., Prebid Server, Amazon TAM/UAM) is a plus
  • Solid understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM/GPT) setups, line items & creatives, key-values, targeting, and delivery debugging
  • Working knowledge of programmatic concepts: OpenRTB, floors, auction dynamics, user sync/ID, brand safety, and viewability
  • Familiarity with privacy frameworks & CMPs (IAB TCF v2.x, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA) and consent-aware ad serving
  • Performance tuning for Core Web Vitals and modern build tools (Webpack/Vite/Rollup)
  • Comfort with Chrome DevTools, network waterfalls, and log-driven debugging; bonus points for Node.js, Cloud Functions, or simple backend endpoints
  • Data fluency: basic SQL or BI tools (Looker/Data Studio/BigQuery) for revenue & latency analysis
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; bias for automation and measurable outcomes

Nice to Have

  • Experience with app/webview monetization, AMP, or SPA frameworks (React/Vue/Svelte)
  • Prebid analytics adapters or custom reporting pipelines
  • Experience with ads.txt/app-ads.txt, sellers.json, supply chain object
  • Knowledge of brand safety & IVT controls, creative QA, and MRC viewability standards
  • Exposure to video (IMA/OMSDK, Prebid Video, VAST/VPAID/VMAP) or CTV/OTT
  • Knowledge in Python and NoSQL is a plus

Why MonetizeMore

  • Remote-first culture with flexible work hours
  • Impact at scale across a large publisher network
  • Smart, low-ego teammates and a culture of experimentation
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, home-office stipend, and learning budget

MonetizeMore is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from diverse candidates.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Marketing Manager role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Marketing Manager to lead marketing initiatives that generate awareness, engagement, and pipeline for our products. This role blends strategy with hands-on execution, from crafting compelling campaigns and driving demand generation, to collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, SDRs, Product, Communications, and Alliances.

As a key contributor to our marketing team, you'll take ownership of high-impact programs including integrated campaigns, product launches, events, and account-based marketing. You'll play a pivotal role in connecting our products with the right audiences whether enterprise customers, developers, or strategic partners. You thrive in fast-paced environments, love experimenting and optimizing based on data. You are passionate about technology, marketing and the use of technology in marketing. You bring curiosity, ownership, and a strong desire to make things better for your campaigns, your team, and your own growth. If you enjoy building smart, scalable marketing engines with a bit of creative flair, we'd love to hear from you.

Location: Remote, EMEA

What your day will look like

  • Own end-to-end go-to-market planning and campaign execution across portfolios, territory or vertical.
  • Develop and lead marketing programs that engage with prospects to drive opportunities and revenue.
  • Collaborate closely with other marketing teams to improve content performance and conversion through data-driven insights.
  • Partner with events, content, paid media, and social media teams to execute integrated campaigns across channels.

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in a marketing role in the technology sector (SaaS or enterprise IT preferred).
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to evaluate performance and optimize for impact.
  • Comfortable balancing strategy with hands-on execution, a true self-starter.
  • Strong storytelling skills—you know how to craft messaging that resonates with both technical and business audiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Adaptable, fast learner with a growth mindset and a passion for innovation.

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at sprints
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds who share the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. Our core values guide us: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We seek to build, innovate and revolutionize financial services and invite you to join us.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated prior success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks, and you should be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.

You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Be customer-facing and serve as the first line of support; own support and deliver an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. (primarily macOS environments).
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.
  • Design, test, build, document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM/Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and improve IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Detail solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and resolve critical issues end-to-end; prioritize help desk tickets and work across sprints with agile practices (Jira).
  • Set personal objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration with tools such as Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; familiarity with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows in Okta; API familiarity and system-to-system integrations.
  • Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; experience with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Proficiency in technical documentation and ticketing (tickets, email, Slack).
  • Strong preference for a clear, friendly, concise communication style and a customer-centric mindset.
  • Understanding of security, PGP concepts, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing/switching), and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line tools to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Fit

  • We seek a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment, values integrity and accountability, and can work remotely with empathy and clarity.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, adaptability, and resilience to navigate ambiguity in a high-growth setting; able to influence across functions and cultures.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards that start on day one, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company.
  • Shared equity so Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the digital economy.
  • Remote work flexibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career and an inclusive, diverse workplace.

Other Notes

You may reach out to the Ledn team for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. Ledn is a global, remote-first team with employees across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response, and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, no unsolicited resumes.
