title: Supervisor (a) de Produção - Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado
description:
Overview

Supervisor (a) de Produção - Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado

KEY EXPECTED ACHIEVEMENTS

  • 1. Member of the Operations team : The Business Unit Leader aims to drive the Shop’s performance first, and actively contributes to the Plant performance in a collaborative manner. They are involved in:
    • a. Sharing best practices between Business Units and helping to contribute to the Plant performance in a collaborative manner. We maintain a mindset of “ONE MANUFACTURING TEAM” in all situations.
    • b. Detecting & developing talents that will grow their career in the Shop. They develop and export talent from their Business Unit to other activities to support business needs.
    • c. Supporting Shop decisions even when uncertainty and unfavorable circumstances may impact their own Business Unit.
    • d. Improving the performance of the Business Unit through regular coaching and feedback of support team members.
    • e. Providing input on the performance of support team members as well as recommendations for development.
  • 2. People developer : The Business Unit Leader is animated with the passion for people development, seeing their plant as a platform to recruit, train & offer professional growth for everyone in their teams. They are expected to:
    • a. Deploy a life-long learning mindset in the teams, through evaluation of competencies and identifying development opportunities to close the gaps.
    • b. Ensure the development of people through the avenue of Spoke training by support teams or through social promotion projects.
    • c. Utilize career paths accessible for all their employees.
    • d. Build and believe in the value of diverse teams.
    • e. Support competency development through mentoring & coaching.
  • 3. Representative/Role model of the Company values, purpose & strategy : The Business Unit Leader represents the Plant for the employees and embodies the group values by:
    • a. Consistently living out the values and acting as an example to inspire their employees by their behaviors.
    • b. Motivating their teams by leveraging the Michelin purpose & Dream.
    • c. Ensuring everyone in their Team understands the Plant strategy and their role in the collective vision.
    • d. Aligning the vision at the shop level and engaging the teams to realize it at the site.
    • e. Embodying company values by addressing employee issues in a timely fashion and ensuring accurate, on-time completion of time and attendance.
    • f. Developing Safety as a value so that each employee is responsible for their safety and the safety of others.
  • 4. Customer & business partner : Understands customers’ needs and business stakes and guides teams to be customer-centric. They are expected to:
    • a. Develop an understanding of the Customer/partners and their requirements and the role their Business Unit has in meeting their expectations.
    • b. Steer the Business Unit toward all dimensions of economic value creation.
    • c. Support the business through cooperation with local teams for industrializations, modifications, digitalization, Industry transformations, etc.
  • 5. Environment promoter : Viewed as an active promoter for continuous improvement in environmental impact by:
    • a. Promoting a culture that is aware of and values sustainability and environment.
    • b. Complying/Implementing the strategy for environmental impact and biodiversity.
  • CARE AREA of EXCELLENCE
  • 6. ICARE & Empowerment role model : Leads with the ICARE leadership model and inspires and coaches their team to progress in that direction. They are expected to:
    • a. Inspire and transfer their passion for ICARE to all employees at all levels, through continuous deployment of the model in their Business Unit.
    • b. Create conditions for inclusion, safe-space, collaboration & collective intelligence in their team.
    • c. Foster empowerment through engaging shop Support Teams so that everyone feels responsible for the plant’s future and can participate in evolution and transformation.
  • 7. Operational Excellence Leader : Develops operational excellence by ensuring that:
    • a. Activities are driven by applying MMW(MDP+OR/MAPP) for sustained foundations and conditions to achieve industrial performance.
    • b. Continuous progress with variation reduction and non-added value task reduction.
    • c. Achieve BU SMQDC expected performance levels and compliance with standards to satisfy customer demand.
    • d. The team and its members are empowered and visibly committed; autonomy increases with evolving polyvalence, competencies and responsibility.
    • e. Uses sound problem solving to eliminate root causes of problems as they arise.
  • 8. Digital and Innovation contributor : Adopt innovation, engineering, and technology to ensure transformation is seen as an opportunity for excellence by:
    • a. Seek opportunities to apply digital applications and encourage the team to work with data-driven approaches.
    • b. Build the foundations for transformation (data quality, competencies, organization, plant roadmap, collaboration with Site Digital Department).
    • c. Trigger projects and initiatives that develop capabilities aligned with the Michelin strategy.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
Overview

Omada Health is on a mission to inspire and engage people in lifelong health, one step at a time.

Job overview: As the Director, Product Design, you will be a pivotal leader within the product organization, responsible for driving our long-term design strategy and cultivating a world-class team dedicated to delivering exceptional user experiences. Reporting to the VP of Product, you will manage the product design team partnering with brand, product, engineering and clinical to ensure a consistent, intuitive, and high-quality experience for both consumers and care team members. Your role will involve collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, engineering, and marketing to align design efforts with broader business objectives. You will spearhead the development of scalable, repeatable design systems and guidelines, while your leadership will emphasize user-centered design, innovation, and compliance. With a focus on personalization for key member segments at various stages of their health journeys, you will ensure that our products drive higher engagement, retention, and outcomes. Your strategic leadership, impeccable design eye, and user-centric approach will be instrumental in guiding the UI/UX vision and its execution across all touchpoints, ultimately achieving measurable impacts on member delight and business success.

Applicants should submit a portfolio showcasing a proven track record in creating consumer-focused UX that solves complex design problems providing impact to customers and the business, ideally within a healthcare category.

Your Impact

  • Team Development and Mentorship: Provide coaching, mentorship, and career development for the product design team to maximize their impact and professional growth.
  • Design Excellence and Learning Culture: Champion best-in-class design practices and foster a culture of continuous learning to elevate design excellence.
  • User Experience and Interface Design: Oversee the development of user-centered design processes, including research and testing, and ensure consistent, appealing UI designs across platforms.
  • Design System: Develop and maintain a scalable design system.
  • Innovation: Encourage innovation through AI and emerging technologies to enhance the design process.
  • Strategic Hiring and Organizational Scaling: Implement strategic hiring practices, effective onboarding processes, and develop a robust organizational design to scale the design team.
  • Vision and Strategy Articulation: Craft and communicate a design strategy that aligns with product and business objectives, while also advocating for the role of design at the executive level
  • Strategic Decision-Making and Leadership: Apply strategic leadership and problem-solving skills to navigate complex challenges and align design efforts with long-term company goals.
  • Clear Expectations and Accountability: Set clear goals, roles, and responsibilities, and establish rhythms of accountability to maintain performance standards and a healthy team culture.
  • Collaboration and Influence: Lead cross-functional collaboration, leveraging influence and communication skills to drive change and align with company values across different departments.
  • Customer Insights: Partner with the user research and clinical teams to gather insights that inform design decisions (research is a partner, not a director report).
  • Compliance: Ensure compliance with accessibility standards and relevant regulations.

About you

  • A Bachelor’s degree in user experience, design, or other related field
  • You have 10+ years of experience in product design, turning complex problems into engaging design solutions
  • You have at least 5 years of experience managing and scaling teams larger than 5 ICs including principal and staff level designers, with a track record of scaling and developing high-performing teams.
  • You have a deep understanding of user-centered design processes and consumer-focused digital experiences
  • You have direct experience driving strategic business outcomes through design of apps, ideally within the health category
  • You possess exceptional strategic thinking and execution skills, capable of translating high-level vision into tactical plans while maintaining a focus on detail.
  • You are a seasoned leader with a strong ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • You are a proactive problem-solver with the ability to navigate complex cross functional challenges and drive clarity in ambiguous situations
  • Appreciation of standards; proven methods and tools to enforce brand identity and consistency across all projects
  • An ability to prioritize work in a fast paced environment and meet changing deadlines and priorities on multiple simultaneous projects
  • Demonstrated expertise in integrating AI, ML, or automation both in design workflows and shipped product experiences.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health

Omada Health is a between-visit healthcare provider that addresses lifestyle and behavior change elements for individuals managing chronic conditions. Omada’s multi-condition platform treats diabetes, hypertension, prediabetes, musculoskeletal, and GLP-1 management. With insights from connected devices and AI-supported tools, Omada care teams deliver care that is rooted in evidence and unique to every member, unlocking results at scale. With more than a decade of experience and data, and 29 peer-reviewed publications showcasing clinical and economic proof points, Omada’s approach is designed to improve health outcomes and contain costs. Our customers include health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, health systems, and employers ranging from small businesses to Fortune 500s. At Omada, we aim to inspire and empower people to make lasting health changes on their own terms. For more information, visit: omadahealth.com

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.

Overview

We are tech transformation specialists, uniting human expertise with AI to create scalable tech solutions.

With over 7.400 CI&Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.

Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma revolução impulsionada pela Inteligência Artificial! Estamos procurando uma pessoa líder com visão estratégica para coordenar a integração de soluções de IA a processos de desenvolvimento de soluções e produtos digitais.

Responsibilities

  • Estabelecer metas claras e padrões claros para a implementação de IA em diferentes ciclos de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC).
  • Assegurar que diretrizes e padrões sejam seguidos, garantindo conformidade com regulamentações internas e externas.
  • Coordenar fluxos de trabalho onde humanos e agentes de IA colaboram em paralelo, gerenciando dependências e lidando com exceções conforme necessário.
  • Compreender como agentes de IA operam, pontos fortes e modos de falha, comunicando-se de forma eficaz com perfis técnicos (menos profundidade e mais visão sistêmica).

  • Estimular experimentação, integração contínua de novas tecnologias de IA no SDLC, garantindo que a equipe desenvolva suas habilidades constantemente.
  • Mediar a confiança nos artefatos gerados por AI, determinando onde são necessárias validações humanas.

Pré-Requisitos

  • Formação Acadêmica: graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Processos: experiência em mapeamento, definição e customização de processos de desenvolvimento.
  • Gestão: experiência em gerenciar o impacto de mudanças em processos, cuidando das comunicações e treinamentos que se fazem necessários.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em Sistemas Multiagentes: Conhecimento em construir e gerenciar sistemas que operam de forma colaborativa e eficiente.
  • Certificações em IA e Mapeamento de Processos: Certificações relevantes em IA e/ou definição/mapeamento de processos.
  • Adaptabilidade: Habilidade em lidar com mudanças, mesmo que frequentes, e evoluir com as necessidades da organização e do mercado.
  • Experiência em Ética e Compliance: Conhecimento sobre regulamentações relacionadas à privacidade de dados e práticas éticas na implementação de AI.

Benefícios

  • Health and dental insurance
  • Meal and food allowance
  • Childcare assistance

  • Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass
  • Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR)

title: Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety

Remote - must be based in Brazil

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves.

Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead our Video Safety engineering team. This critical role involves overseeing the development and enhancement of our innovative video safety software product, designed to improve the safety of commercial truck drivers on the road. Our system utilizes in-cab dashcams to detect and report safety-critical events such as driver fatigue, close following, and lane departure warnings. These events are then reviewed by back-office administrators via a dedicated portal.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and coach team members, providing regular feedback and supporting their professional growth and career development.
  • Implement and maintain high engineering standards, best practices, and processes across the team to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and reliable software.
  • Coordinate and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and other engineering teams, to align on goals and deliver integrated solutions, working with a global team spanning North America, Europe, and Latin America (Brazil).
  • Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Drive technical excellence and innovation, ensuring the team leverages appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
  • Ensure the team's adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience.
  • Act as a technical leader, providing guidance and expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS), backend development (Kotlin), and front-end technologies (React).
  • Champion a safety-first mindset within the engineering team, ensuring the product's features and performance directly contribute to safer driving practices.
  • Knowledge of Kotlin and Java

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience in software development in a leadership or management role.
  • Proven experience managing and leading high-performing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical proficiency in cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others relevant to scalable applications.
  • Experience with front-end technologies, particularly React.
  • Demonstrated experience with scaled, high-availability systems.
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum) and best practices.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of leading with empathy, fostering a positive team environment, and effectively managing individual and team performance.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with video processing, computer vision, or IoT applications is a plus.
  • Advanced/Fluent english is mandatory - written and speaking

Desired Attributes

  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to understand the broader business context and translate it into technical strategies and team goals.
  • Result-Oriented: Drives for measurable results and holds the team accountable for commitments.
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience.
  • Collaborative: A natural team player who builds strong relationships and fosters a cooperative work environment.
  • Passionate about Safety: Genuinely cares about the impact of our product on commercial truck driver safety.

title: SDR Pleno
description:
Overview

SOBRE A BUZZCREATORS
A Buzzcreators é uma plataforma brasileira especializada em conectar marcas com influenciadores, especialmente micro e nano influenciadores, para a criação e gestão de campanhas de marketing de influência. Ela oferece uma solução automatizada e baseada em dados para facilitar todo o processo, desde o planejamento até a execução e pagamento das campanhas.

Vaga - 100% HOME OFFICE

O que buscamos

O SDR em vendas (Sales Development Representative, ou Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas) terá a responsabilidade de identificar e qualificar leads, estabelecer contatos, criar oportunidades de negócio e auxiliar os times comerciais. Além disso, atuará na etapa pré-vendas, com habilidades específicas, antes de as vendas começarem.

Atividades

  • Prospecção ativa 100% focada em Outbound de empresas e agências interessadas e com potencial para se tornarem clientes Buzzmonitor;
  • Compreensão das necessidades/dores de negócio do cliente;
  • Apresentação de plataforma para solucionar essas necessidades;
  • Mapeamento de necessidades e potenciais projetos.

REQUISITOS

  • Ensino superior em andamento ou completo;
  • Experiência na posição de SDR/Inside Sales;
  • Experiência com metodologia de venda BANT;
  • Experiência com Google Docs ou Microsoft Office;
  • Experiência com processo outbound;
  • Experiência com criação de listas.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Técnica de vendas: Spin Selling;
  • Prospecção ABM;
  • Experiência no setor de Marketing Digital;
  • Experiência com Atendimento (SAC 4.0);
  • Experiência com tecnologia ou software SaaS;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de captação de cliente e validação de email (Sales Engagement).

Overview

Company : Highmark Inc.

Job Description : JOB SUMMARY

This job manages a team of Case Managers charged with promoting quality member outcomes to optimize member benefits and to promote effective use of resources for members enrolled in DSHP Plus LTSS. Provides direct oversight to Case Managers, meets all of the requirements of a Case Manager and be able to assist in the day to day responsibilities of a Case Manager as needed. This is a full time community based position requiring frequent travel within the assigned territory in Delaware.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of community based Case Managers.
  • Promote quality member outcomes to optimize member benefits and to promote effective use of resources.
  • Act as a role model to staff and assisting in the day to day activities as needed.

  • Review documentation and processes for consistent practice, and to identify opportunities for growth.
  • Initiate and implement process improvements.

  • Identify and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Suggest new approaches to complex problems.

  • Adhere to all company, State and Federal requirements related to privacy practices, HIPAA, and quality performance standards.

  • Medicare and Medicaid experience
  • Managed care experience

Skills

  • Leadership skills and be able to relate to all levels of management and staff as well as individuals external to the corporation
  • Leadership, collaboration, and motivational skills
  • Ability to multi task and perform in a fast paced, and often intense environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to analyze data, measure outcomes and develop action plans
  • Team player that possesses strong analytical and organizational skill

title: Principal Architect São Paulo, Brazil, Remote
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A \"Whatever it takes\" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

  2. People developer: the Business Unit Leader is animated with the passion for people development, seeing their plant as a platform to recruit, train & offer professional growth for everyone in their teams. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • a. Deploy a life-long learning mindset in the teams, through evaluation of competencies and identifying development opportunities to close the gaps.
    • b. Ensure the development of people through the avenue of Spoke training by support teams or through social promotion projects.
    • c. Utilize career paths accessible for all their employees.
    • d. Build and believe in the value of diverse teams.

    • a. Consistently living out the values and acting as an example to inspire their employees by their behaviors.

    • c. Making sure that everyone in their Team understands the Plant strategy and understands the role that they play in the collective success of the vision.

    • e. Embodying the values of the Company by ensuring employee issues are addressed in a timely fashion. Ensure accurate, on-time completion of time and attendance for employees and address attendance issues in a timely fashion.

    • a. Develop an understanding of the Customer/partners and their requirements and the role their Business Unit has in meeting their expectations.
    • b. Steer their Business Unit, focused on all dimensions of economic value creation.
    • c. Support the business through a cooperation with local teams for: industrializations, modifications, digitalization, Industry transformations, etc.

    • a. Promoting a culture that is aware and values sustainability and environment.
    • b. Complying/Implementing the strategy for environmental impact and biodiversity.

Care Area of Excellence

  1. ICARe & Empowerment role model: the Business Unit Leader is visibly striving to lead with the ICARE leadership model and inspires and coaches their team to progress in that direction. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • a. Inspire and transfer their passion for ICARE to all employees at all levels, through the animation of a continuous deployment of the model in their Business Unit.
    • b. Create the condition for inclusion, safe-space, collaboration & collective intelligence in their team.
    • c. Foster empowerment through the engagement of their shop Support Teams, so that everyone can feel responsible for the plant’s future and fully take part in the evolution and transformation.
  2. Operational Excellence Leader: the Business Unit Leader is committed to develop the operational excellence by ensuring that:
    • a. Activities are driven by applying MMW(MDP+OR/MAPP), because the teams understand the value of such practices of excellence. Foundations are sustained over time, in order to create the conditions to achieve industrial performance.
    • b. The driving of continuous progress in the Business Unit, looking for variation reduction and non-added value tasks reduction, is vigorous.
    • c. Achieve Business Unit SMQDC expected performance levels and respect of standards to satisfy customer demand.
    • d. The team and its members are empowered and visibly committed. Autonomy increases through the evolution of polyvalence, competencies and responsibility.
    • e. Uses sound problem solving methodology to eliminate root causes of problems as they arise.

Tech Area of Excellence

  1. Digital and Innovation contributor: Adopt innovation, engineering, and technology ensuring the transformation is recognized as an opportunity for excellence by:
    • a. Seeking opportunity to apply and encourage team to work with and use digital application where appropriate. Apply “use cases” to help team move forward to data driven approach.
    • b. Helping to build the foundations necessary for the transformation (data quality, competencies, organization, plant roadmap, collaboration with Site Digital Department).
    • c. Supporting and triggering projects and initiatives that will develop capabilities aligned with the Michelin strategy. Highlight the importance to copy/paste digital good practices.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Estamos em busca de Gerentes de Vendas Jr para colaborar e contribuir com nossa equipe de Vendas no Brasil, agregando aos valores de Liderar, Vender e Vencer.

description:
Overview

Senior Solution Architect - Customer Success (Brazil) at Articul8 AI. You will shape GenAI-based solutions, working with customers' technical and business leaders to understand gaps and objectives, and craft scalable, reliable, and cost-effective architectures.

About us

At Articul8 AI, we relentlessly pursue excellence and create exceptional AI products that exceed customer expectations. We are a team of dedicated individuals who take pride in our work and strive for greatness in every aspect of our business. We believe in using our advantages to make a positive impact on the world and inspiring others to do the same.

Job Description

Articul8 AI is seeking an exceptional Solution Architect to join us in shaping the future of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI). You will work within the Product Technology team with customers’ technical and business leaders to understand their technical gaps, needs, and business objectives. You will craft GenAI-based solutions that promote innovation and accelerate bringing new products to market. This role offers opportunities to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners to drive enterprise-grade GenAI innovations.

Responsibilities

  • Solution Design: Develop detailed, scalable architectural designs addressing client needs using Articul8 products and third-party tools.
  • Piloting and Prototyping: Run pilot programs with customers to demonstrate feasibility and advantages; introduce new features or build prototypes as needed.
  • Client Interaction: Engage with clients through workshops, meetings, and presentations to communicate solutions and best practices.
  • Performance Optimization: Optimize for performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness; select instance types, auto-scaling configurations, and storage options.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure solutions meet security best practices and regulatory requirements; implement IAM, data encryption, and related measures.
  • Documentation and Training: Create comprehensive architecture documentation and provide training to clients or internal teams.
  • Teamwork: Collaborate with Applied Research, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Customer Success to maintain product technology leadership.
  • Leadership: Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of rapid innovation.

Required Qualifications

  • Professional experience: 2+ years in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructure; 4+ years in technology domains such as software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics.
  • Education: BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technology stack: Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); Languages (Python, Node.js, Go, Ruby); APIs/Integration (OpenAPI, FastAPI, Swagger, Flask, REST); Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis); ML Frameworks (PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Keras); Development/Deployment (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes); Monitoring/Logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK); Version Control (Git, GitHub, GitLab); Architecture Design/Modeling (Microsoft Visio, Drawio); Collaboration/Project Management (JIRA, Confluence, Trello).
  • Education: Master’s or PhD in Computer Science or related fields preferred.
  • Experience developing tools, libraries, and infrastructure for data preprocessing, model training/finetuning, and deployment of LLMs in research and production environments.

Professional Attributes

  • Problem Solving: Breaks down complex problems into manageable components and devises creative solutions with iterative refinement.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Works effectively in cross-functional teams, communicates clearly, and respects diverse perspectives.
  • Project Management and Prioritization: Balances multiple projects, sets milestones, and monitors progress; allocates time efficiently between short- and long-term goals.
  • Critical Thinking: Evaluates assumptions, questions methodologies, and remains skeptical when interpreting results.
  • Curiosity and Continuous Learning: Maintains a proactive approach to learning and staying updated on related fields.
  • Emotional Intelligence and Intellectual Humility: Demonstrates empathy, resilience, adaptability, self-awareness, and collaboration.

title: Supervisor (a) de Produção - Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado
description:
Supervisor (a) de Produção - Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado

Key Expected Achievements

  1. Member of the Operations team: the Business Unit Leader aspires to drive the performance of the Shop first, even before their own Business Unit. For this, they are actively involved in:
    • a. Sharing best practices between Business Units and helping to contribute to the Plant performance in a collaborative manner. We maintain a mindset of “ONE MANUFACTURING TEAM” in all situations.
    • b. Detecting & developing talents that will grow their career in the Shop. They develop and export talent from their Business Unit to other activities to support business needs.
    • c. Supporting Shop decisions even when uncertainty and unfavorable circumstances may impact their own Business Unit.
    • d. Improve the performance of the Business Unit through regular coaching and feedback of support team members.
    • e. Provide input on the performance of support team members as well as recommendations for development.
  2. People developer: the Business Unit Leader is animated with the passion for people development, seeing their plant as a platform to recruit, train & offer professional growth for everyone in their teams. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • a. Deploy a life-long learning mindset in the teams, through evaluation of competencies and identifying development opportunities to close the gaps.
    • b. Ensure the development of people through the avenue of Spoke training by support teams or through social promotion projects.
    • c. Utilize career paths accessible for all their employees.
    • d. Build and believe in the value of diverse teams.
    • e. Support competency development through mentoring & coaching.
  3. Representative/Role model of the Company values, purpose & strategy: the Business Unit Leader represents the Plant for the employees. They embody the group values by:
    • a. Consistently living out the values and acting as an example to inspire their employees by their behaviors.
    • b. Motivating their teams by leveraging the Michelin purpose & Dream.
    • c. Making sure that everyone in their Team understands the Plant strategy and understands the role that they play in the collective success of the vision.
    • d. Aligning the vision at the shop level and engaging the teams to make that vision a reality at the site.
    • e. Embodying the values of the Company by ensuring employee issues are addressed in a timely fashion. Ensure accurate, on-time completion of time and attendance for employees and address attendance issues in a timely fashion.
    • f. Developing Safety as a value in the Business Unit, such that each employee is responsible for their safety and the safety of others.
  4. Customer & business partner: the Business Unit Leader understands the customers’ needs and the business stakes and guide the teams to be customer centric. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • a. Develop an understanding of the Customer/partners and their requirements and the role their Business Unit has in meeting their expectations.
    • b. Steer their Business Unit, focused on all dimensions of economic value creation.
    • c. Support the business through a cooperation with local teams for: industrializations, modifications, digitalization, Industry transformations, etc.
  5. Environment promoter: the Business Unit Leader is viewed as an active promoter and influencer for continuous improvement in the environmental impact of their Business Unit by:
    • a. Promoting a culture that is aware and values sustainability and environment.
    • b. Complying/Implementing the strategy for environmental impact and biodiversity.

Care Area of Excellence

  1. ICARe & Empowerment role model: the Business Unit Leader is visibly striving to lead with the ICARE leadership model and inspires and coaches their team to progress in that direction. The Business Unit Leader is expected to:
    • a. Inspire and transfer their passion for ICARE to all employees at all levels, through the animation of a continuous deployment of the model in their Business Unit.
    • b. Create the condition for inclusion, safe-space, collaboration & collective intelligence in their team.
    • c. Foster empowerment through the engagement of their shop Support Teams, so that everyone can feel responsible for the plant’s future and fully take part in the evolution and transformation.
  2. Operational Excellence Leader: the Business Unit Leader is committed to develop the operational excellence by ensuring that:
    • a. Activities are driven by applying MMW(MDP+OR/MAPP), because the teams understand the value of such practices of excellence. Foundations are sustained over time, in order to create the conditions to achieve industrial performance.
    • b. The driving of continuous progress in the Business Unit, looking for variation reduction and non-added value tasks reduction, is vigorous.
    • c. Achieve Business Unit SMQDC expected performance levels and respect of standards to satisfy customer demand.
    • d. The team and its members are empowered and visibly committed. Autonomy increases through the evolution of polyvalence, competencies and responsibility.
    • e. Uses sound problem solving methodology to eliminate root causes of problems as they arise.

Tech Area of Excellence

  1. Digital and Innovation contributor: Adopt innovation, engineering, and technology ensuring the transformation is recognized as an opportunity for excellence by:
    • a. Seeking opportunity to apply and encourage team to work with and use digital application where appropriate. Apply “use cases” to help team move forward to data driven approach.
    • b. Helping to build the foundations necessary for the transformation (data quality, competencies, organization, plant roadmap, collaboration with Site Digital Department).
    • c. Supporting and triggering projects and initiatives that will develop capabilities aligned with the Michelin strategy. Highlight the importance to copy/paste digital good practices.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn\'s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

Role and Responsibilities

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We\'re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You\'re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints). You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

You Bring to Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite. Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc. Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc. You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta. You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another. You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs. Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.

You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.

Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit). You\'ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort. Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications. Culture Fit: We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The ideal candidate will

Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices. Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day! We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions). A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do. We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; knowledge of APIs and system integrations
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; handling hardware shipping/receiving and customs
  • Exceptional communication skills across all media; clear writing for tickets, email, and Slack

  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and OSI model; ability to troubleshoot methodically
  • Self-management and the ability to scope projects and work across multiple teams

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS
  • Experience using GAM and command‑line tools to increase efficiency
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications
  • Culture fit: thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies Ledn values

Culture Fit

  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability with confidential information
  • Collaborative partner across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity
  • Experience working in a remote environment and navigating ambiguity

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one
  • Competitive PTO and ownership in the company through equity
  • Remote-friendly policy allowing work from anywhere globally for up to 180 days per year
  • A purpose-driven career and a commitment to removing barriers so you can do your best work

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. Overview

Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN .

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and are passionate about providing an outstanding experience to employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We are primarily Mac environments. You will procure and deliver technology equipment and manage tech onboarding for new employees and tech retrieval for departing employees.

You will design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge. You will support and manage SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta). You will create solution documentation and automation to reduce manual work. You will manage incidents and tickets, prioritize workload, and participate in projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods. You will set objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn: 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite). Automation skills (bash, zsh, python). Experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.). Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows, and work with APIs to connect systems. Remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs. Excellent written and verbal communication across media. Ability to draft clear tickets, emails, and Slack messages. Comfort with security principles and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, OSI model). Self-management with the ability to scope work and coordinate across teams. Strong organizational and task-management skills; comfort with ambiguity.

Nice to Have: Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces; certifications (Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace). Culture fit: leadership mindset, adaptability, empathy, and a collaborative approach in a remote, fast-paced environment.

What We Provide

Comprehensive total rewards package, remote-friendly with up to 180 days remote eligibility (subject to restrictions); ownership in the company through equity; a purpose-driven career; inclusive, diverse, and equal opportunity employer. We welcome accommodation requests via email for recruitment process stages; responses are confidential.

Company and Hiring Notes

Ledn’s team is global, remote-first, with presence across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is committed to helping end users. You will design, implement and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks, and collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams (Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR). The role reports to the Director of IT.

What You Will Do

  • Provide customer-facing IT support; own support channels via Slack, Jira, etc.; manage Mac endpoints and enterprise macOS deployments.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding experiences; design, test, build, and document programs, policies, tools, and improvements to knowledge base.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM/Jamf).
  • Contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.); write solutions, help articles, and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents; prioritize help desk tickets; work on projects over sprints using Jira and agile methods.
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Experience creating automations with Bash, Zsh, Python; using open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows; strong API integration skills; remote support across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across all media; ability to explain complex concepts clearly and calmly; strong ticketing and documentation skills.
  • Proficient in troubleshooting and macOS enterprise environments; strong networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing); understanding OSI model layers and methodical troubleshooting; self-management and multi-team coordination.
  • Strong organizational and task-management skills; ability to handle ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience using GAM and CLI tools; Jamf and Okta certifications; Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: leadership in a startup/tech environment with values alignment.

Benefits and What We Provide

  • Comprehensive total rewards package and competitive PTO; ownership in the company through equity; remote work eligibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose; removal of barriers to help you love what you do; inclusive, diverse environment; equal opportunity employer.

Working Environment and Miscellaneous

Ledn is globally distributed with a remote-first environment. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; we may review publicly available social media relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

You will support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.) and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools.   • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and work across multiple teams.

Culture Fit : We value leadership that thrives in startup or tech environments and embodies our values of progress, integrity, collaboration and empathy. A builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices; ability to influence across functions; and a track record of integrity and accountability in handling confidential information.

You will be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment and able to work with high motivation, dependability, and experience in a fast-moving team. You will collaborate with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.   • You will work on projects over sprints and document work in Jira, applying agile methods.
  • You will set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.

  • Experience with open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta.
  • Experience working with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; familiarity with hardware shipping and customs.
  • Strong communication skills across all media; ability to explain concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Excellent written communication for tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, concise writing; culturally sensitive.
  • A genuine desire to provide a magical experience for others; strong security mindset and knowledge of PGP.
  • Fundamental networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching) and OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and align work across multiple teams; strong organizational and task-management skills.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete data.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; prior hands-on use is helpful.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to streamline work.
  • Jamf, Okta, and Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We value leadership that thrives in startup or tech environments and embodies our values.
  • Ability to adapt, be resilient, and navigate ambiguity in a high-growth setting.
  • Builder’s mindset: eager to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Collaborative partner with empathy and clarity, capable of influencing across functions and cultures.
  • Integrity and accountability, especially in handling confidential information across diverse contexts.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

Transformando mercados com tecnologia há mais de 30 anos. Nós impactamos vidas através da Tecnologia.

Fomos pioneiros na digitalização da Justiça brasileira e seguimos expandindo os limites do que é possível com Inteligência Artificial.

Estamos desenvolvendo um produto de alto impacto para a Justiça , que combina IA generativa, segurança de dados e arquitetura escalável para apoiar magistrados e tribunais em decisões mais céleres, consistentes e explicáveis.

É um desafio inédito: aplicar IA de ponta em escala nacional, com rigor técnico, responsabilidade e impacto direto na vida de milhões de cidadãos.

Além da engenharia, buscamos alguém com perfil de evangelização técnica — capaz de documentar entregas e descobertas, apresentar resultados em fóruns internos e externos, compartilhar boas práticas e contribuir para disseminar uma cultura de IA ética, segura e orientada a impacto.

Você fará parte da equipe que está construindo uma das arquiteturas de IA mais avançadas já aplicadas ao sistema de Justiça .

O projeto combina múltiplas camadas tecnológicas, vetorização semântica, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), multi-LLMs e pipelines distribuídos, para compreender grandes volumes de dados jurídicos de forma segura e explicável.

O impacto vai além da tecnologia: cada decisão apoiada pela nossa IA pode representar mais eficiência, menos morosidade e mais acesso à Justiça para a sociedade.

É uma jornada que une ciência de dados, engenharia de alta performance e ética no uso da IA, buscando profissionais que queiram atuar na fronteira entre inovação tecnológica e transformação pública.

Como Cientista de Dados com foco em IA Generativa, você será responsável por:

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de IA do produto, garantindo escalabilidade, rastreabilidade e explicabilidade.
  • Liderar iniciativas com LLMs, embeddings e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para geração de soluções seguras e contextualizadas.
  • Aplicar fundamentos de estatística, probabilidade e algoritmos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clusterização etc.) em análises e avaliações de performance.
  • Orquestrar integrações entre sistemas judiciais, serviços em nuvem e provedores de IA .
  • Projetar, implementar e monitorar pipelines envolvendo vector DBs e frameworks de GenAI ( LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, entre outros) .
  • Criar e refinar engenharia de prompts em cenários complexos e diversos.
  • Traduzir resultados técnicos em insights claros e acionáveis , comunicando descobertas e limitações a públicos diversos (técnicos e executivos).

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds who share the conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building Ledn to be an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be passionate about innovation and creative problem solving, and adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. This role requires a highly motivated, dependable technologist who shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You’ll Do

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support and provide an outstanding experience to employees via tools such as Slack and Jira.
  • Support macOS in an enterprise setting; procure and deliver technology equipment; own onboarding and offboarding experiences.
  • Design, test, build, document programs and policies, and contribute improvements to knowledge resources.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM with Jamf, etc.).
  • Own and improve IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Document solutions, craft help articles, and automate routine tasks.
  • Manage incidents and issues to resolution; prioritize help desk tickets; work on projects over sprints with Jira (agile methods).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned to team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc., and to use open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; handling hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across all media; ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication sensitive to different cultures.
  • Security-minded with understanding of PGP; knowledge of networking fundamentals and OSI model troubleshooting; ability to self-manage and scope projects across teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and command-line interfaces to increase efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We look for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will be adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth environment; possess a builder’s mindset; be a collaborative partner who can influence across functions with empathy and clarity; demonstrate integrity and accountability; and have remote-work experience.

What We Provide

  • Competitive total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a PTO package and equity ownership in the company.
  • Remote-work opportunity up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a focus on removing barriers so you love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusivity and diversity.

Equal Opportunity and Recruitment Notes

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. We are a remote-first, global team and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We may request a short video response or review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. Due to high application volume, only qualified applicants will be contacted. No agencies or recruiters, please.

We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values.
